messages.subject: Error when creaing Mesh
parts:
Hi All,

I am getting the following error after running inla.mesh.create. 

mesh.dummy=inla.mesh.create(loc=borders,extend=list(n=20, offset=1),refine=FALSE)
Segmentation fault (core dumped)

Error in fmesher.read(prefix, "manifold") : 
  File '/tmp/RtmpdVVEHk/fmesher493a60db4c.manifold' does not exist.


What could be the cause?

Thanks
